newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends off as interest rates fall.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends off as interest rates fall.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed off for the fifth straight session at 477.25/478.50 per dollar as benchmark six-month TEM yields fell 55 basis points to 12.97 percent, traders said, with further falls in the bolivar seen.
"The market was very busy, with strong Central Bank participation more than matched by high corporate dollar demand," said one trader.
The bolivar had closed Tuesday at 475.00/476.00.

Brokers said Thursday would likely see the bolivar soften further on continuing high dollar demand. Yields on six-month TEMs at the Central Bank's regular weekly auction have fallen consecutively for a month.
